summary: Everything on our side of the Free Tax Prep launch stays built and ready. The approved strategy, keyword map, and campaign architecture are staged in both Google and Meta, waiting only on the landing page going live.
coverSub: Launch-readiness report: where the Free Tax Prep campaign stands, what's staged, and the one dependency between here and live.
headline: The campaign is fully staged and launch-ready in both Google and Meta. One dependency remains: the Free Tax Prep landing page. The day it ships, ads can be live within 24 hours.
snapshotLead: Strategy, keywords, and campaign builds are done and QA'd. Launch readiness held at 95% all month while we waited on the landing page.
takeaway: Nothing decays while we wait: audiences, keywords, and creative stay staged and re-checked. The moment the landing page URL exists, we flip the switch and start learning from real traffic.
